parallel.requirements: The parent identified exact CLI, bytes repr, construct Int8ul range, stderr/stdout, ESM, .mjs, zero-dependency, and no forbidden API requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It delegated a six-phase workflow: three implementation candidates, difftest, judge, finalize, critics, repair, and final gate.
parallel.implementation: Several candidates were attempted; c2 returned a complete 9-file /tmp/cand_c2 bundle and reported differential/self-test success, while c1 and c3 branches stalled or were interrupted.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No child result was promoted into /output; parent polls showed /output empty and artifact validation later found no files.
parallel.verification: The parent relied on workflow-local testing; c2 self-reported 110 differential cases and sweeps, but the workflow final acceptance gate did not return.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official artifact was empty after a process timeout, so the delivered parallel solution failed all 126 evaluator samples despite available candidate work.

serial.requirements: The single actor recognized the same CLI, int parsing, bytes repr, construct range, stderr, ESM, .mjs, and /output requirements from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It kept probing, implementation, debugging, verification, and delivery in one local thread without subagents or workflow handoffs.
serial.implementation: It created a hierarchical /output implementation with argparse, construct, Python byte/int/repr helpers, traceback handling, and test3.mjs.
serial.integration_and_delivery: All modules and the entry file were written directly into /output and artifact validation listed the complete tree.
serial.verification: It ran sample checks, a 561-case differential sweep, edge-case stderr comparisons, found and fixed a Unicode-digit bug, and investigated traceback cwd behavior.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The shell process timed out after useful work, but the artifact already passed the official 126/126 evaluator samples.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the ESM, .mjs, no external dependencies, manual argv parsing, output location, and exact behavioral matching requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and recognized the same output, CLI, module, and zero-dependency obligations.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-reading difference; the divergence comes from how the solution was delivered after that shared understanding.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel delegated to a workflow with three independent candidates, per-candidate difftests, judging, finalization, critics, repair, and a final gate.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept ownership in one actor, creating /output and then writing modules and the entry point directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced many dependent stages before final delivery; serial used a direct single-owner path to the required artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs carried a detailed measured spec and candidate root contracts, so the main context issue is not missing requirements in the briefs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained the same behavioral facts in one thread while refining modules and fixes locally.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel context was transferred into child work correctly enough for c2 to build a candidate, but coordination state remained trapped in the workflow instead of becoming a final artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel generated at least one complete candidate implementation in /tmp/cand_c2 with test3.mjs and supporting .mjs modules after extensive probing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the implementation directly under /output/lib and /output/test3.mjs, including argparse, construct, bytes/repr, int, and traceback modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel implementation existed only as a candidate outside the deliverable tree; serial implementation was the deliverable tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent launched one workflow, received repeated TaskOutput timeouts, and the saved workflow state ended killed with c2 done but finalize/gate not complete.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept local results in the main trajectory and continued fixing after mismatches until the artifact existed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel did not complete the child-result-to-final-artifact lifecycle; serial did not need a join and directly preserved its work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel candidate files lived in /tmp/cand_* roots and /output remained empty when the parent inspected it and when artifact validation ran.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial integrated all modules into the required /output tree, and artifact validation listed test3.mjs plus the lib tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel shared state was isolated but never promoted; serial integrated into the required final state.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel c2 reported 110 differential cases and byte sweeps, but the workflow-wide final gate did not run and official evaluation saw no artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran sample checks, a 561-case differential sweep, edge-case comparisons, and then official evaluation passed 126/126.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification remained candidate-local and unaccepted; serial verification supported the actual delivered artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the 2399-second budget with a killed workflow, stalled retries, and an empty artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also reached the outer timeout, but after creating a valid artifact that official evaluation accepted.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both were time-limited, but parallel closed before final placement while serial closed after delivery.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The parallel run failed officially because its multi-agent workflow did not convert completed candidate work into the required /output artifact before the global timeout: status shows an empty artifact and 0/126. The serial run, despite also reaching the outer time limit, had already written the full /output tree and official evaluation passed 126/126. The concrete solution difference is final delivery and artifact lifecycle, with checkpoint-free retries and late finalization delaying the parallel workflow.
parallel_contributors: A stalled c1 implementation branch was retried from the same broad prompt without a visible checkpoint, repeating setup and probing work.
A complete c2 candidate stayed under /tmp/cand_c2 while workflow finalization into /output was never reached.
The parent continued waiting on workflow completion while /output remained empty and the official artifact copy later found no files.
serial_contributors: The serial run wrote the final module tree and entry test3.mjs directly into /output.
The serial run ran broad differential tests, fixed a Unicode digit issue, and left a valid artifact before closure.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial performed local code edits and bug fixes on the delivered artifact; parallel c2 may have had high-quality code, but it was never submitted as the artifact.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause

candidates.reason: Implementation was explicitly owned by three implementation children, and serial used one direct implementer; the failure was not an unassigned implementation task.
The delegated candidates were alternative complete bundles rather than separately owned components needing cross-agent integration.
The workflow explicitly assigned a Finalize phase to write /output, so assembly had an owner even though it was reached too late.
The workflow script itself owned the end-to-end pipeline from implement through acceptance gate; the pipeline overran rather than lacking an owner.
Initial reference probing informed implementation but did not stand as a single mandatory preflight gate that alone blocked productive work.
The parallel run launched implementation children after probing and had active implementation work; the failure is not a pure investigation phase deferring all production.
There is no separate evidence that auxiliary work starved an otherwise unstaffed critical path; the retained episodes better explain the retry and final placement failures.
The broad workflow created budget pressure, but the concrete retained episodes are the checkpoint-free stalled-child retry and the completed candidate left unpromoted.
Some child scopes were broad, but c2 completed and the incomplete c1/c3 branches are better captured by checkpoint-free retry/stall handling.
The child prompts included the known task source, measured behavior, hard output requirements, and self-test obligations; no already-known requirement was omitted from the brief.
The children built independent complete candidates, not separately owned interoperating components with an omitted interface contract.
No known finding is shown disappearing through transfer; the c2 result remained present in the workflow journal/state.
The problem was not an overlarge returned report that a receiver tried and failed to reduce; the workflow had not reached final synthesis.
No receiver consumed a superseded workspace or stale requirement state that caused an inconsistent action.
No incompatible child reports were both received and left unadjudicated at an integration decision point.
The parent did not present the whole task as complete; the official artifact was empty rather than an accepted but unverified deliverable.

The initial c1 child was interrupted, and the replacement c1 child restarted from the same broad implementation prompt without a checkpoint of prior findings, then repeated probing/coding and remained unfinished.
candidates.realized_consequence: The c1 branch spent retry budget repeating setup and reference exploration rather than resuming from prior work, keeping that branch unfinished while no final artifact was produced.
candidates.near_match_reason: The retry consumed budget, but the directly evidenced boundary is replacement without inherited checkpoint state, not a standalone collective fan-out label.

No broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion replaced a final workspace tree.
Concurrent writes were isolated under separate /tmp candidate directories, and the adverse event was non-promotion, not unstable shared writes.
No generated file or temporary artifact from one actor was consumed by another as the reference environment.
